name: What is the difference between a natural gas line and a propane line for a pool heater?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a natural gas line and a propane line for a pool heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference lies in the fuel source and delivery. Natural gas is supplied via an underground utility line from a municipal provider, offering a continuous supply without needing refills. Propane, on the other hand, is stored in a tank on your property and requires periodic refilling by a supplier. Both require specific piping and heater configurations. While natural gas is often more cost-effective if available, propane offers flexibility for properties without natural gas access. The choice depends on your utility availability and personal preference.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural gas is piped from a utility, offering continuous supply. Propane is stored in a tank and refilled. Choice depends on availability and preference.
